issue.title: Restore the baseline full test suite
issue.description: A clean just test run after just install completed with 24,941 passed, 366 failed, 7 skipped, and 1 collection error. Failures span unrelated areas and appear to reflect a branch-wide test/code/golden mismatch: tests/ace/tui/test_admin_center_selection_resume.py cannot import _patch_store_loader from test_tasks_pane; many tests still expect Artifacts key 5 to open prs while the app opens files; Changespec onboarding text/order expectations omit the Beads subtab; Agents footer fixtures lack _has_bulk_read_undo_available; and many ACE PNG goldens differ. Reconcile the affected tests and visual snapshots with current production behavior, then restore just test.

payload.entry: Consolidating duplicate reports sase-do (308 failures), sase-du (313 failures), and sase-dp (Tasks PNG fixture timing out on artifacts_subtab=files after page.press("5")). All three describe the same branch-wide Artifacts subtab/test/golden mismatch.

payload.close_reason: No longer reproducible on master 5143cb981: just test reported 25391 passed, 7 skipped, and only 2 unrelated failures (test_statistics_facade_smoke_through_real_bindings and test_facade_does_not_use_synthesized_terminal_timestamp); none of the reported sase-dw failures recurred. test_admin_center_selection_resume.py now imports patch_store_loader as _patch_store_loader, _has_bulk_read_undo_available is defined in agents/_unread_state.py and used by leader mode, and just test-visual reports 405 passed, 1 skipped. Absorbed duplicates sase-do, sase-du, and sase-dp.
